definition_en: an amount that a person can carry in one or both arms
core_image: 双臂圈住的一捧花柴书报
scene: 秋日的院子里落叶铺了一地，孩子们跑来跑去。She gathered an armful of firewood from the porch.
sceneCN: 这里 armful 是「一抱之量」（第 1 个义项：双臂能抱住的数量）；句意是她从门廊抱来一捧柴火。

derivatives.zh: 同缀 -ful 名词，义为「一把之量；（比喻）少数」
同缀 -ful 名词，义为「一口之量」
同缀 -ful 名词，义为「一匙之量」
基础词，义为「手臂」，armful 由其派生

senses.title: As much as the arms can hold
senses.definition: the quantity of things that can be carried in one's arms at one time
senses.definitionCN: 一次用双臂能抱起的数量
senses.example: He picked an armful of apples from the lowest branches.
senses.exampleCN: 他从最低的枝头摘了满满一抱苹果。
senses.why: The suffix -ful turns a container or holder into a measure word.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ful 把「容纳者」变成量词，手臂成了天然容器。

senses.title: A person or animal carried in the arms
senses.definition: a child, pet or other being small enough to be carried in the arms
senses.definitionCN: 小到可以被双臂抱住的孩子、宠物或其他生物
senses.example: The toddler ran back to be an armful again.
senses.exampleCN: 幼儿跑回来重新让大人抱个满怀。
senses.why: The measure word extends from things to beings small enough to fill the arms.
senses.whyCN: 量词从物延伸到「小得能填满双臂」的生命。

intro.en: Armful is a transparent English compound of arm plus the suffix -ful.
intro.cn: armful 是 arm 加后缀 -ful 的透明英语复合词。

items.en: The root *h2er- is reconstructed as to fit together, source of arm (joint, limb).
items.cn: 重构词根 *h2er- 义为「接合」，是 arm（肢节）的来源（重构形式）。

items.en: Arm meant the limb from shoulder to hand, borrowed early from Latin armus.
items.cn: 古英语 arm 指肩至手的肢体，很早就借自拉丁语 armus。

items.en: -ful already meant full of or as much as a holder contains in Old English.
items.cn: 古英语中 -ful 已表「充满」或「容器所容之量」。

items.en: Armful is first recorded in the seventeenth century among measure compounds like handful.
items.cn: armful 于 17 世纪首见，与 handful 等量词复合词同期。

items.en: Plural is armfuls, though archaically armfuls and armsful both appear.
items.cn: 现代复数为 armfuls，旧文献亦见 armsful。

note.en: The -ful measure family all follow the pattern: holder + ful.
note.cn: -ful 量词家族一律遵循「容纳者 + ful」的构词式。

entries.definition: as much as the hand can hold
entries.definitionCN: 一把之量，与 armful 同用 -ful 量词后缀

entries.definition: a place where weapons are stored
entries.definitionCN: 军械库，词首 arm 与 armful 拼写相近但词义无关

entries.definition: an older plural form of armful
entries.definitionCN: armful 的旧式复数，今罕用

entries.definition: a group of things tied or carried together
entries.definitionCN: 捆在一起或一起搬运的一组东西，与「一抱」量相近

entries.definition: whatever is carried at one time
entries.definitionCN: 一次所载之物，泛指而不限双臂
杂乱的一堆，侧重堆放而非抱取

normalIntro.en: Read the word literally: arm + ful = arms full.
normalIntro.cn: 按字面读：arm + ful 即「双臂装满」。

normal.en: arm + ful = as much as your arms hold.
normal.cn: arm + ful 即「双臂能抱住的量」。

normal.en: Same pattern: handful, mouthful, spoonful, cupful.
Plural is armfuls, not armsful in modern English.
normal.cn: 现代复数是 armfuls，不是 armsful。

normal.en: Common phrases: an armful of flowers, an armful of books.
normal.cn: 常见搭配：一捧花、一抱书。

normal.en: It can even mean a small child carried in the arms.
normal.cn: 它甚至可指被抱着的小孩。

abstract.en: Feel the weight of wet laundry pressed against your chest.
abstract.cn: 感受湿衣裳压在胸前的重量。

abstract.en: Smell an armful of freshly cut lilacs on a spring morning.
abstract.cn: 闻一抱春晨新剪的丁香。

abstract.en: See a child wrapping both arms of a parent like a ring.
abstract.cn: 想象孩子像环圈一样箍住大人的双臂。

examples.en: She carried an armful of roses into the kitchen.
examples.cn: 她抱着一捧玫瑰走进厨房。

examples.en: The librarian handed me an armful of atlases.
examples.cn: 图书管理员递给我一大摞地图册。

examples.en: Grandfather came in with an armful of kindling for the stove.
examples.cn: 祖父抱着一抱引火柴走进屋来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿姆·扶」——阿姨（阿姆）抱着一抱柴，一把扶住歪倒的箱子，两只手都被占满了，正是一抱之量。

root: 英语本土复合：arm（臂，源自拉丁语 armus「肩」）+ -ful（表「充满／一容之量」的名词后缀）。

sensesIntro.en: From the quantity the arms hold to a small being carried in them.
sensesIntro.cn: 由「双臂所容之量」延伸到可抱在怀中的小孩或宠物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: both arms curled around as much as they can grip
core.cn: 核心意象：双臂圈到极限的一抱

branches.en: arms used as a natural measure
a being small enough to hold
the weight of what one carries
carrying as an act of care
branches.cn: 抱着这一动作中的呵护

intro.en: The suffix -ful builds measure nouns from body parts and containers.
intro.cn: 后缀 -ful 由身体部位或容器构成量词名词。

latinIntro.en: Arm itself is one of the few Latin loans already present in Old English.
latinIntro.cn: arm 属于古英语时代已存在的少数拉丁借词之一。

as much as fills the mouth
